sanskrit: imās tapantu tvauṣadhīr oṣadhīnām ayaṃ rasaḥ | aśvatthas te 'yaṃ hṛdy agnir bhūto vy oṣatu pra patāto mamādhyā ||
english: May these herbs scorch you; this is the essence of all herbs. This aśvattha-fire, having become a flame in your heart, shall burn it utterly — fly hither, into my longing!

sanskrit: yathā sūtraṃ lākṣāraktam ājyenānuṣicyate | evā te kāmaḥ sarpatv antar asthasu majjasu pra (…) ||
english: As a thread dyed crimson with lac is suffused with clarified butter, so let desire for me creep into you, deep within your bones and marrow — fly hither!

sanskrit: yathā kuṣṭhaḥ prayasyati yathā dahyate arciṣā | evā te dahyatāṃ manaḥ pra (…) ||
english: As the kuṣṭha plant pines and wastes, as it burns in the flame, so let your mind burn — fly hither!

sanskrit: puṃsaḥ kuṣṭhāt pra kṣarati stoka ādhībhir ābhṛtaḥ | sa te hṛdaye vi vartatāṃ pra (…) ||
english: A drop laden with anguish trickles out from the kuṣṭha of a man; may that very drop churn round and round inside your heart — fly hither!

sanskrit: eṣa te stoko hṛdayaṃ digdheveṣuḥ pra padyatām | astrākhaṇaṃ yatheṣvā kāmo vidhyatu tvā mama pra (…) ||
english: Let this drop strike your heart like an arrow smeared with poison; as an arrow cleaves its target, may desire for me pierce you through — fly hither!

sanskrit: harita edhi śuṣkākṣaḥ sarvadā hṛdayāmayi | striyas te anyā mā chāntsur atho tvāśābhi śocatu pra (…) ||
english: Become pale, become hollow-eyed, ever sick at heart! Let no other woman please you; let longing for me blaze upon you — fly hither!

sanskrit: śocīmad astu te śayanaṃ śocīmad upaveśanam | śocīmad astu te mano yathātra na ramāsā arvācī na manāsa pra (…) ||
english: Let your bed be full of burning torment, let your seat be full of burning torment, let your mind be full of burning torment — so that you shall find no rest here, nor turn your thoughts elsewhere — fly hither!

sanskrit: na ramāsai saṅgateṣu śayānaṃ tvābhi śocatu | stokas tvottuda ut tudāt pra (…) ||
english: You shall take no delight in assemblies; let longing torment you as you lie down; let the drop sting you and sting you again — fly hither!

sanskrit: antar dahati carmaṇo asthimāṃsebhir ābhṛtaḥ | sarvān yajñaḥ pra yāśayād aiḍa ādhībhis tava pra (…) ||
english: It burns within, laden with your skin, bones, and flesh. May this sacrificial rite rout all others, O Aiḍa, through your torments — fly hither!

sanskrit: hṛdaye 'dhi sam idhyatāṃ svair māṃsebhir eṣa te | agniḥ kāmasya yo mahān sa mahyaṃ randhayāti tvā pra (…) ||
english: Let this fire blaze up in your heart, kindled by your own flesh — the great fire of desire; may that great one subdue you to me — fly hither!

sanskrit: aśvattham agnim ājyaṃ dūtān kṛṇve manojavān | agniś carum ivārciṣā kāmo vidhyatu tvā mama pra (…) ||
english: I make the aśvattha tree, Fire, and clarified butter my messengers, swift as thought. As Agni strikes a sacrificial oblation with his flame, may desire for me pierce you — fly hither!

sanskrit: śayānam agna āsīnam aśvatthaś ca savāsinau | carantam upatiṣṭhantaṃ mamādhibhir vi vidhyataṃ pra (…) ||
english: O Agni and Aśvattha, you two who dwell together — whether he lies down or sits, whether he walks or stands still, pierce him through with my anguish — fly hither!

sanskrit: carantaṃ tvā tiṣṭhantam āsīnam api saṃsadi | reṣmā tṛṇam iva mathnātu dahan kāmaratho mama pra (…) ||
english: Whether you are walking, standing, or sitting, even in the assembly — let the fire-stick churn you like dry grass; may my chariot of desire burn you as it drives — fly hither!

sanskrit: yathendrāyāsurān arandhayad bṛhaspatiḥ | evā tvam agne aśvatthān amūn mahyam ihānaya pra (…) ||
english: As Bṛhaspati subdued the Asuras for Indra's sake, so do you, O Agni of the aśvattha, bring those men here to me — fly hither!

sanskrit: ahaṃ te mana ā dada aiḍena saha medinā | devā manuṣyā gandharvās te mahyaṃ randhayantu tvā pra (…) ||
english: I take your mind and bind it together with Iḍā's fat portion. May the gods, human beings, and Gandharvas all subdue you to me — fly hither!

sanskrit: yathā aśvatthasya parṇāni nelayanti kadā cana | evāsau mama kāmena māva svāpsīt kadā cana pra patāto mamādhyā ||
english: As the leaves of the aśvattha tree never come to rest at any time, so may that man never sleep at peace because of his longing for me — fly hither, into my longing!

sanskrit: kuṣṭhaṃ tapanti marutaḥ svādhyaṃ dūra-ājānaṃ svarayanto arciṣā | yathā na svapāt katamac canāhar aiva gacchān mamādhyā ||
english: The Maruts heat the kuṣṭha plant, excellent for meditation, known from afar, resounding with their flame — so may he not sleep; may not a single day pass but that he comes into my longing!
